body.p: Two men lived. One was Iwul, the other was Akaramo. They went to hunt herds [of wild reindeer]. They sailed, sailed, sailed along the river, they saw an elk cross the river. Iwul said: "Holy dogspirit, I will run quickly." Iwul ran through the water quickly. He ran, he ran past the elk. Akaramo followed him. He found Iwul's foot. Akaramo carried it, followed him again, he found the other foot, he carried it again, he found a hand, he kept walking. He went there, he found the other hand, took it. He walked along the elk's traces, he found his torso, he carried it. He found his head. It [the head] said to Akaramo: "Stop looking at me, put the feet together!" Akaramo put the whole body together, Iwul became a human again. Iwul walked with Akaramo again. Akaramo said: "I will hunt elks, you go hike and pitch the tent on [the mountain] Chino." Akaramo went hunting. He killed two elks, followed Iwul's traces. Iwul cried there, he could not carry the tent poles up the Chino, he carried up [only] one. Akaramo said: "Iwul, what are you doing?" "Oh, why did you tell me to pitch the tent on the Chino!" "Hike, pitch the tent by the rapids", Akaramo said. Iwul quickly [went] to pitch the tent. Akaramo came back, he said again: "Iwul, what are you doing there?" "Why did you say, that I should pitch the tents by the rapids! How am I to pitch the tent in the water?" Then Iwul hunted elks, he himself went hunting. Akaramo hiked off. Iwul brought two reindeers, he walked, there was a river. Iwul said to the reindeer: "Untie the shoes! How do you not understand?" There Iwul flayed the reindeer's feet. The reindeer died. Iwul saw an elk there, he called out to the elk: "Reindeer of the holy father, koo, koo, koo!" This one started running. Iwul kept walking. He saw a wolverine there, he called out again: "Dog of the holy father, ol, ol, ol!" The wolverine ran off. Iwul returned home, he came back. Iwul said to Akaramo: "There they [the reindeer] took their shoes off, when they had, they slept." Akaramo scolded Iwul: "Why did you kill the reindeer?" Akaramo left on his own. There he met Evenki. Akaramo said: "Did you kill my male reindeer?" The Evenki said: "We did not kill it." "You killed it." The Evenki killed Akaramo. Akaramo shouted: "Iwul, come here! The men are squashing me! Quick!" Iwul came, he held blood soup. Akaramo wrestled with the men. Iwul said: "You pour out the blood soup!" Akaramo turned(?) over Iwul's broth, he said: "Kill! Take your bows and shoot!" Iwul killed all of the Evenki. He left again with Akaramo to go hunt partridges. Akaramo came, Iwul said: "How did you hunt?" "This is how I hunted! You hunt the partridges. I call for the partridges, you keep watch there!" Iwul started calling out: "Partridges, come to the middle of my bow!" The partridges fell on his stomach. Iwul started laughing, he was ticklish. "Aha-ha-ha, I cannot endure this when they fall!" The partridges all flew away. Iwul did not kill one, did not catch one. He came home, Akaramo was not at home. Akaramo brought a calf there. Iwul said: "Say, how did you catch the calf?" "I stole it from an old woman." "I found it in the morning." In the morning Iwul went there. Iwul shot a castrated reindeer, he carried it. The old woman came, she held a leather fuller, she came there. She punched Iwul in the face with the leather fuller. Iwul started crying, Akaramo said: "Why are you crying?" "The old woman hit me in the face with the leather fuller." "Why did you kill the castrated reindeer? I told you to kill a calf." Again, Akaramo and Iwul went. Akaramo brought a stone, he said: "Iwul, take this! There is an elk!" Iwul took it. The stone squashed him, Iwul died.
